ValidationRule.description: VR.CALC.05 — Prevents deletion of Accrual Daily rows that are linked to an active Calculation Run. The row must be set to an inactive status before removal.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISNEW()), NOT(ISCHANGED(Is_Immutable__c)), NOT(ISNULL(Calculation_Run__c)), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status__c, 'Superseded')), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status__c, 'Cancelled')), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status__c, 'Voided')), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status__c, 'Capitalised')) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: This Accrual Daily row cannot be deleted because it is linked to an active Calculation Run. Void or supersede the row first.
